Definition: to meander (causatively, guide) about, especially for trade or reconnoitring
BiblicalUsage: 1) to seek, search out, spy out, explore; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to seek out, select, find out how to do something; 1a2) to spy out, explore; 1a2a) explorers, spies (participle); 1a3) to go about; 1a3a) merchant, trader (participle); 1b) (Hiphil) to make a search, make a reconnaissance
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
